subject: general
question: For humans, the audible waves are those that:

options.text: have the frequency range between 20 Hz to 2000 Hz
have the frequency range between 20 Hz to 20000 Hz

solution:
The correct answer is __**have the frequency range between 20 Hz to 20000 Hz**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• For humans, the audible waves are those that **have the frequency range between 20 Hz to 20000 Hz**.
 
• The human ear is capable of detecting sound frequencies from approximately **20 Hz to 20,000 Hz**, which is the range of sound wave frequencies that can be heard by the average person.&l
